primary_direction: Everyday salvage becomes threatening because a mirror offers the familiar woman in an independently acting state. The fragile open carton, shut exit and contradictory mirrored action belong to one interrupted practical task.
who: Fictional adult woman carrying a damp open carton of household photographs; reference appearance only. Her specific presence comes through visible bob, bangs, eyes, facial geometry, careful load-bearing grip and momentary attention to the mirror.
where: Upper-floor self-storage office, leak and half-lowered shutter make salvaging vulnerable photographs consequential. A stored framed mirror leaning against a wall plausibly belongs among household objects.
how: Viewer close enough to assess the real face, carton and reflected hand, with real person and reflected self occupying separate readable parts of the frame.
why_now: Rain damage has reached the photographs and the exit is narrowing. She has just lifted the carton and discovers that the mirror has changed the present task into an encounter.

alternatives_compared.direction: The mirror repeats the woman holding a different carton state only
alternatives_compared.merit: Quiet temporal mismatch with restrained staging
alternatives_compared.weakness: A closed reflected carton alone could be mistaken for ordinary occlusion or a second object

alternatives_compared.direction: A mirrored hand presses the glass while both real hands support a damp open carton; reflected carton is dry and closed
alternatives_compared.merit: A single clear broken body-object relationship concentrates the threat at the glass, with material mismatch as subordinate continuity cue
alternatives_compared.weakness: Requires both real hands, mirror edge, reflected palm and faces to remain readable; framing must serve those relationships
